items.scope: Third-party products it researches.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.

All Ping Identity and ForgeRock products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Ping Identity or ForgeRock that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
SailPoint issues only.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Pandora FMS, Pandora ITSM, and Pandora RC issues only.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in runZero products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, runZero that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Juniper issues only.
Vulnerability assignment related to FSI’s vulnerability coordination role in the South Korea financial sector that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vivo issues only.
Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.
All products and projects in which OpenVPN is directly involved commercially and for OpenVPN community projects, including Private Tunnel.
All HYPR products only.
Vulnerabilities identified in Cribl products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Cribl that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered in Extreme Networks, Inc.’s products and services.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Microchip Technology products only.
JetBrains products only.
Synology issues only.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
ELAN issues only.
Current versions of LINE Messenger Application for iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows, plus LINE Open Source projects hosted on https://github.com/line.
Vulnerabilities in linqi products only.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Kubernetes issues only.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
Supported Secomea products only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Teltonika Networks products and services only.
Vulnerabilities in Intigriti products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Intigriti that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
All Netskope products and services.
